description: This file is a React component for the homepage of a recipe application. It handles displaying a list of recipes, including a loading state with skeletons, filtering recipes based on search input, and showing a message when no results match. The component imports several other components and data sources, and manages its internal state and effects.

methods.name: Home({ debouncedSearch })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the homepage for recipe discovery, including search filtering, loading simulation, and conditional rendering of recipe cards or messages.
